to: airCFO ( https://aircfo.com ) project owner via the HN-listed application channel
subject: Five-minute LLM integration demo for airCFO ( https://aircfo.com ) — Founding Engineer
body:
Hello airCFO team,

Came across your Founding Engineer post in the July 2026 HN Who's Hiring thread (the aircfo.com listing). You're calling out RAG + Python + LLM integration specifically, and for a CFO-outsourcing service that shape is high-stakes in a way a generic LLM pilot isn't: retrieval that returns the wrong invoice or misclassifies a transaction becomes a client-facing accounting error, not a prompt-eval curiosity. That's the wedge for a bounded paid pilot rather than a Founding Engineer FTE pitch: I take one retrieval seam — document ingest -> account/vendor classification, say — and ship a small slice with a deterministic acceptance test plus a low-confidence refusal path, so ambiguous inputs surface for human review instead of getting a confident wrong answer.

Proposed first milestone (paid, fixed-scope):
1. Reproduce one representative RAG->classification seam on synthetic/non-sensitive documents.
2. Add the low-confidence refusal boundary + an exportable JSON receipt.
3. Hand over the code, a short runbook, and one acceptance check airCFO can re-run.

Proof: https://hfo-games.pages.dev/ ships 21 live browser games (short-loop delivery), and https://github.com/TTaoGaming/hfo-gen-133 exposes the append-only receipts and operator-gated effect model I use to keep AI work auditable. I'm pitching bounded integration labor — not applying for the Founding Engineer seat.

If that retrieval seam is real for airCFO, book a 15-minute look at the attached demo: {{OPERATOR_BOOKING_LINK}}. If not, no follow-up.

— TTaoGaming
https://github.com/TTaoGaming
